values.note: 2027 on the booking site: $37 a night at the 20/30-amp sites ($40 on the July Saturday sampled), $42/$45 at the 13 sites on the 50-amp fee schedule; hike-in tent sites H1-H8 $32/$35. 2026 (DNR rates table): $35 at 20/30-amp sites, $40 at 50-amp, hike-in $27. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Pinckney Recreation Area, Bruin Lake maps: 143 campsites on fee schedule -32663 at $35 for 2026-10-27/11-07, $37 for 2027-05-18 and 07-13, $40 for 2027-07-17; 13 on fee schedule -32664 at $40 / $42 / $45; 8 on -32474 at $30 / $32 / $35) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Pinckney, Bruin Lake: Modern camping 50 AMP rate $40, 20/30 AMP rate $35; Bruin Lake Hike In: $27) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/pinckney ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/pinckney (Bruin Lake tags 'Electrical service', 'Some campsites with 50-amp service') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (Bruin Lake maps: 143 campsites 'Electrical Service=20 Amps/30 Amps', 10 '20 Amps/30 Amps/50 Amps', 3 '50 Amps', 8 hike-in 'Not Available'; all 'Sewer Hookup=No'; water hookup not listed), read 2026-10-25

values.note: DNR: 161 sites. The booking site's three Bruin Lake maps hold 164 campsites, 8 of them hike-in tent sites (H1-H8) that the DNR lists as the separate Bruin Lake Hike In campground; trailers/RVs allowed up to 50 ft at 13 sites and 25 ft or more at 137; 22 sites take tents or truck campers only. Posted site lengths 15-65 ft. No pull-throughs.

values.note: Reserve online on MiDNRReservations or at 800-447-2757.

note: Modern campground on Bruin Lake, one of a chain of seven lakes, at 21237 Kaiser Rd, Gregory; lower loop mostly paved, upper loop grass/dirt. Boat launch and a campers-only swim beach. Season ~Apr 15-Nov 1. --Claude
